sources.title: Experience Replay for Continual Learning (Rolnick et al.)
sources.authority_reason: Authors' original research manuscript hosted by arXiv, not a third-party summary.
sources.inspection_note: New-task updates can degrade old-task performance; retaining old capacities is distinct from acquiring new capacities; rehearsing old data and mixing new/replay experience is a method of retaining prior behavior. Personally read PDF p.1-3 and verified version on p.1 and arXiv submission history. CLEAR includes actor-critic learning, off-policy corrections and behavioral-cloning terms and evaluates RL domains. Its performance, 50/50 mixture, buffer results and losses are not claimed for this course's supervised VQA or text replay. Only mechanism/definition and before/after task measurement are used.

sources.title: A mixture mean can change solely through its group weights
sources.details: For unchanged per-group mean losses 1 and 4, text position share 0.25 yields 0.25*1+0.75*4=3.25, while text share 0.75 yields 0.75*1+0.25*4=1.75. No individual task improvement is assumed. This is a numerical possibility check, not an observed model result.
